name: convergent
description: Deterministic multi-agent implementation and adversarial review loops powered by GitHub Copilot.

chatParticipants.name: convergent
chatParticipants.description: Implement a task through convergent multi-agent review

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Plan and implement a task using the convergent review workflow

convergent.models.coordinator.description: Coordinator model selector. Use an exact Copilot model id/name, or one of: strong, cheap-a, cheap-b, auto.

convergent.models.workerA.description: Persistent worker A model selector. cheap-a prefers a low-cost Anthropic model when available.

convergent.models.workerB.description: Persistent worker B model selector. cheap-b prefers a low-cost non-A worker model when available.

convergent.models.reviewer.description: Strong reviewer model selector. The reviewer context is retained for the lifetime of one implementation task.

convergent.maxWorkerPasses.description: Maximum A/B review/fix passes per convergence cycle, excluding the initial implementation pass.

convergent.maxReviewerCycles.description: Maximum strong-review remediation cycles per implementation task.

enumDescriptions: Automatically approve normal workspace reads, writes, and commands; still ask for risky operations.
Ask before shell commands and writes.
convergent.permissionMode.description: How Copilot SDK tool permission requests are handled.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/orchestrator/engine.js && node --check src/copilot/session-factory.js
